notes: Named pools omit automatically applicable governed-Skill Talent, one declared Specialty and relevant external dice.
Defense depends on how the attack reaches the target, not whether it is magic or physical.
Pick one available named defensive response, which supplies floor(total dice/2) static opposition. A declared mode must contain one or more defenses or explicitly say that no defense applies.
Physical projectiles do not allow default Parry; direct nonmissile Maledictions cannot be Dodged, Blocked or Parried.
Ordinary social attacks may directly mark only Soul's Attention. Only supernatural attacks may directly mark Soul's Plasticity. Conviction provides resource capacity and effect soak, not Avoidance.
Alternate defenses require circumstances in catalog; countermagic requires access to a reaction or counterspell, not free universal use.
Social attack attributes may cross categories: physically imposing intimidation uses Strength + Speechcraft Accuracy by default; Charisma + Speechcraft Potence.
